list.name: home_id
list.label: Home
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT home_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 1

list.name: plug_id
list.label: Plug (non-general)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT plug_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND plug_id <> 'general' AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time,
  AVG(voltage) AS value,
  home_id AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
           AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: GENERAL – Avg Real Power W = V*I*PF (per minute)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time,
  AVG(COALESCE(voltage,0) * COALESCE(current_amp,0) * COALESCE(power_factor,0)) AS value,
  home_id AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
           AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time,
  AVG(voltage) AS value,
  CONCAT(home_id, '/', plug_id) AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
           AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: PLUGS – Avg Real Power W = V*I*PF (per minute)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time,
  AVG(COALESCE(voltage,0) * COALESCE(current_amp,0) * COALESCE(power_factor,0)) AS value,
  CONCAT(home_id, '/', plug_id) AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
           AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  ts,
  home_id,
  plug_id,
  voltage,
  current_amp,
  power_factor,
  energy_wh
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
           AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50
